steps.title: Configure an unattended SDK job
steps.code:
allowedTools: [
        "Read",
        ...(fix ? ["Edit", `Bash(${LINT})`, `Bash(${TEST})`] : []),
      ],
      permissionMode: "dontAsk",
      maxTurns: fix ? 10 : 6,
      maxBudgetUsd: 0.35,
      effort: "low",
      thinking: { type: "disabled" },
steps.explanation: settingSources is empty, tools are declared, turns and estimated spend are finite, and dontAsk denies unresolved calls. It is not bypassPermissions. Callback hooks still enforce the trusted fixture scope.
steps.narration: Step 8. settingSources is empty, tools are declared, turns and estimated spend are finite, and dontAsk denies unresolved calls. It is not bypassPermissions. Callback hooks still enforce the trusted fixture scope. This source excerpt shows the corresponding application statement.

steps.title: Permit only exact fixture commands
steps.explanation: Fix mode permits only the exact linter and test commands. The harmless forbidden-command test is deliberately deferred to native dontAsk, which must deny it. Every other command is refused by the host.
steps.narration: Step 9. Fix mode permits only the exact linter and test commands. The harmless forbidden-command test is deliberately deferred to native dontAsk, which must deny it. Every other command is refused by the host. This source excerpt shows the corresponding application statement.

steps.title: Consume the actual SDK stream
steps.explanation: The real SDK owns model/tool orchestration. Preserve native messages, tool requests and the final result instead of creating a manual model loop or simulated responses.
steps.narration: Step 10. The real SDK owns model/tool orchestration. Preserve native messages, tool requests and the final result instead of creating a manual model loop or simulated responses. This source excerpt shows the corresponding application statement.

steps.title: Independently verify the model fix
steps.explanation: Only after exact fixture validation may the host execute its known linter and tests. The API key is removed from these verification processes. A model claim that lint passed is not accepted as verification.
steps.narration: Step 11. Only after exact fixture validation may the host execute its known linter and tests. The API key is removed from these verification processes. A model claim that lint passed is not accepted as verification. This source excerpt shows the corresponding application statement.

steps.title: Map native and policy checks to a gate
steps.code:
return input.nativeSuccess &&
    input.validated &&
    input.denials === 0 &&
    (input.lint === undefined || input.lint === 0) &&
    (input.tests === undefined || input.tests === 0)
    ? 0
    : 1;
}
steps.explanation: Require native success, valid fixture state, no denials and successful required checks. Thus an SDK success can still produce a failed CI gate when real lint fails.
steps.narration: Step 12. Require native success, valid fixture state, no denials and successful required checks. Thus an SDK success can still produce a failed CI gate when real lint fails. This source excerpt shows the corresponding application statement.
